sample_unit: Reddit AskDocs posts about possible stroke symptoms

links.outcome: Advising ED visit for suspected stroke posts, LLMs vs neurologists
links.effect: Neurologists advised ED visit in 58.5% vs ChatGPT 45% and Gemini 45% (p < 0.001); LLMs gave 'Unable to determine' in 11.5% (ChatGPT) and 14.5% (Gemini) vs 0% for neurologists.
links.quote: Neurologists were much more willing to advocate for visiting the ED (58.5%) than ChatGPT (45%) or Gemini (45%) (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates performance and triage safety of ChatGPT-4 and Gemini compared to neurologists using Reddit posts of suspected stroke without testing a specific organizational deployment practice.
